text: Pre-freeze API cleanup complete: removed the extraction-era AesEnv alias/object plus env/fromEnv identities and the deprecated SceneConformance facade; canonical public names are AesSpec, ScaleRegistry, and RendererConformance. Renamed their suites/files accordingly. Repository-wide scalafmtAll plus testAll passes with 910 tests (363 core JVM, 354 core JS, all other module counts unchanged). This exact cleaned commit will become the self-contained pre-release baseline; no external consumer repository is part of the policy or gate.
